**Is your feature request related to a problem?**

**Proposed solution**

- Type: [trigger / action / condition]
- Name: [e.g., set_grayscale]
- Parameters: [e.g., on: Boolean]
- Requires Shizuku: [yes / no]

**Device compatibility**
Which Nothing phone models should this work on?

Any other context or references.
